description: Branch protection unreadable and no --required-context given. The verdict must be query-error, not pass: with an empty required set every loop is vacuous and 'all 0 required check(s) completed successfully' is a green earned by asking nothing. What this case discriminates is refusing to guess versus guessing — the naive watcher assumes every observed job is a gate and answers pass off a single unrelated success. It does NOT pin which of the two guards produced the verdict: deleting cmd_poll's refusal leaves this case green, because classify()'s own guard then raises and the verdict is query-error either way. The two differ in the message a human reads, not in the exit code, and the importable guard has its own assertion in the harness.
